content.comment_body: For those working with [version_no], which files go where, and in what sequence? The download contains several .bin files: u_bm1 to 3 and bm_font.bin.

Instructions for upgrading the [product_name] firmware: 1. Download the necessary update files. 2. Unpack the downloaded files and update [product_name] Soft Comfort to [version_no]. 3. Use [product_name] Soft Comfort to copy and back up the program in [product_name] to your PC. 4. Place the firmware update files in the root directory of the MSD card. These files are located in the [product_name] update folder (4 files total). Modifying file names or their location will prevent [product_name] from completing the update. 5. Turn off the power supply to [product_name]. 6. Insert the MSD card with the firmware files into the [product_name] card holder. 7. Turn the power supply back on. Ensure a stable power supply throughout the update process as described in the manual. Once finished, confirm the firmware update was completed. 8. If needed, transfer the saved program back to [product_name] and adjust settings. 9. Check and adapt the program and settings as needed. 10. Note the firmware change on the [product_name] device with a marker pen. Alternatively, you can install the latest firmware update for [product_name]: This is relevant for addressing security vulnerability CVE-2020-7593. In your case, you can update from [version_no] to [version_no].

analysis.insight_summary: User is unsure about the firmware update process for a [product_name] device, specifically regarding the required .bin files and their correct placement. The instructions stress the importance of proper file handling and folder structure, as any changes can disrupt the update. There is a clear need for more straightforward communication and guidance to avoid mistakes and reduce risks during the firmware upgrade.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects precise instructions for firmware updates, specifying which files to use, their order, and storage location, aiming to reduce error risk and prevent update failures.
